12 (Currently Amended): The accessory defined in claim 11 wherein said power supply component includes a coil having a configuration for being disposed about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator, further comprising an additional fastener for removably securing said coil about the power cable.

19 (Currently Amended): A surgical method comprising: providing a surgical instrument having a handpiece, a transducer or generator of ultrasonic mechanical vibrations disposed in said handpiece and a probe attached to a distal end of said handpiece and operatively connected to said transducer or generator; providing a light source; applying a fastener to said handpiece to attach said light source thereto so that light from said light source is directed substantially parallel to said probe; operating said surgical instrument to apply ultrasonic vibratory energy to a surgical site; during the operating of said surgical instrument, conducting electrical energy from a power supply to said light source; and during the operating of said surgical instrument and the conducting of said electrical energy, illuminating said surgical site with light from said source.

21 (Currently Amended): The surgical method defined in claim 20 wherein said power supply includes a coil, the removable mounting of said power supply at least indirectly to said handpiece including securing said coil about a power cable feeding said transducer or generator.

25 (Currently Amended): An accessory for a medical instrument comprising a handpiece and a probe or tool extension on a distal end of said handpiece, said accessory comprising: a light source; a fastener for removably attaching said light source to said instrument; and at least one power supply component operatively connectable to said light source, said power supply component including a coil arranged for being secured about a power cable extending to said handpiece, further comprising an additional fastener for removably securing said coil about the power cable.
